notes: Names: the street I call Badgly Avenue is printed W BADGLY S AVE. north of Tarrant Street (W. Badgly's Avenue?) and BADGLY ... AVE. south of Kentucky Avenue; same alignment, interrupted by the McClure tract. Carlin Street likewise appears in three pieces on one alignment (label CARLIN / ST.). The 46 ft avenue running north-north-east from Chase Avenue to Kirby Avenue carries only AVE. north of the bend; I take it as Virginia Avenue continuing (VIRGINIA is printed south-west of Chase). Chase Avenue: the east-west Chase Avenue meets Virginia at 1456,4640, and the diagonal piece labelled CHASE AVE. (50 ft) leaves Virginia at 1313,4752 to the north-west and continues as LEHER ST. (30 ft, reading uncertain). ? at 2097,1323 and 2746,1322: 25 ft street along the top neat line, only ST. printed. ? at 1428,1537: unnamed 30 ft street. Virginia/Kirby: Virginia peels off Kirby just south of that top street, a long acute junction with the wedge tip near 2690,1555. Martha/Carlin: Martha Street merges into Carlin at an acute angle around a small triangular island (1305-1345, 1650-1740); the point given is where the centrelines meet, the open plaza centre is nearer 1300,1720. Schneider: suffix not read (label runs off my strip). ? at 659,5194: a road stub entering Colerain from the west plate edge, printed RD. only. Kentucky/Leeper: north of Kentucky the same road is printed QUARRY STREET, south of it LEEPER AVE.; the road is partly cut by the plate edge. Sagateo Alley: reading of the name uncertain. HANIFIELD is the printed spelling. Kirby Avenue south of Chase is read from the KIRBY label just north of Chase at x 2830; Kirby x Chase is near 2800,4952 (outside x 2700, not recorded). Unnamed alleys not recorded: 20 ft alley north of Robley at x 2145; 20 ft alleys at 880-930,3860-4030 and 1290-1440,4170-4480; 12 ft alleys round the block between Jerome and Georgia south of Chase. Martha Street suffix not printed in my strip (assumed Street).
